author: YugantG
quote: I don't even own the game as I got PC but looking at youtube clips and my understanding of the story, its not looking good for rockstar. Probably the worst GTA game they have released. Nobody wanted a love story doing house chores and groceries for lucia. There are strip clubs but no prostitutes which makes no sense in a GTA game.
